summary: Iteration 13 regression after code-quality batch (DEMO_PASSWORD env, useCallback refactor, loan_optimizer helper extraction, NearbyMarketCard sub-components, expires_at enforcement). 19/19 pytest passing (loan_optimizer grid=20 rows, summary keys intact, leverage_xirr_pct >=0 everywhere, subvention => pre_emi=0 across all 20 rows, demo-login returns is_demo:true, fake Google session_id => 401, invalid public will-review/witness-sign tokens => 404, portfolio summary/timeline OK, calc/emi OK, market/nearby OK). Frontend smoke: demo login redirects to /app, zero React key warnings on Dashboard/Portfolio/Will/Tenants/Calculators/Advisor/Properties/Referrals, XIRR add-row grows row count cleanly (8 -> 12), /lawyer-review/:bad and /witness-sign/:bad show 'Invalid or expired' error states. Google Auth href on /login correctly targets auth.emergentagent.com with redirect to {origin}/app (URL-encoded as expected by browser).

issues: Recharts prints 'width(-1) height(-1)' warnings repeatedly when a chart container is rendered at 0x0 (likely a hidden tab). Non-blocking but noisy in console.

action_items: (Optional) Guard Recharts ResponsiveContainer with a minHeight/minWidth or conditional render when its parent is not yet laid out to silence 'width(-1) height(-1)' warnings on Portfolio page.
(Optional, carry-over from iter 12) data-testid wrapper on LawyerReview / WitnessSign error-state branch still relies on text-only verification.
critical_code_review_comments: loan_optimizer helpers (_optimizer_pre_emi, _optimizer_horizon_projection, _optimizer_xirr_for_dp) are clean, single-purpose and produce identical grid shape/values; main handler is now a thin orchestrator. Good refactor.
DEMO_PASSWORD now reads os.environ.get('DEMO_PASSWORD') or secrets.token_urlsafe(24) — safe fallback. Verified env var is set in /app/backend/.env so demo-login works.

public/will-review and public/witness-sign GET + submit routes now parse expires_at via datetime.fromisoformat and return 410 when past-due. Branch tested implicitly via invalid token 404 path; expired-path requires DB fixture to trigger and was not directly exercised.
/app/backend/server.py is still ~4851 lines — modularization (routers per domain) remains pending from iteration 12.
Frontend Login.jsx google redirect is built with encodeURIComponent(window.location.origin + '/app') which renders in the anchor as URL-encoded %2Fapp — correct and matches spec.
AuthContext skipping /auth/me when URL contains a session_id fragment is correct (prevents racing Google-session exchange).

success_rate.frontend: 100% smoke (8 routes loaded, 0 key warnings, 0 page errors beyond expected 401 on /auth/me pre-login)

test_credentials: demo via POST /api/auth/demo-login (cookies-based); admin admin@estima.com / Admin@123

Under construction + subvention_by_builder=true forces pre_emi_monthly and pre_emi_total to 0 on every grid row. Google session endpoint is POST /api/auth/google/session {session_id} — NOT GET (returns 405 for GET). Public will routes /lawyer-review/:token and /witness-sign/:token render 'Invalid or expired' text on bad token (status 404 from API, shown as toast + centered message).
rca of the issue: N/A — no regressions. Code-quality batch verified clean.
